baseline.source: v1.1.6's closing full gate, run again alone on the owner's answer (DL-205), meeting every line: 50 games of 20 years in 8 processes, the replay kept; moved from v1.1.5's closing sweep (m9-v115-s13, e7ae1710…, DL-184) by v1.1.7-S8 (DL-214)

run.source: v1.1.5's Gate sweeps, S3 to S13, each 50 games of 20 years (DL-177 to DL-184); the gate profile (DL-186 item 13)

refusals.source: M2-S12 (DL-34): the policy chooses only what the rules accept, so a refusal is a bug; 0 at v1.1.6's close (DL-205)

invalid.source: M2-S12 (DL-34): a game the validator refuses; 0 at every close; read only when validated after every advance, which a Gate run is not (v1.1.6's was not, DL-205)

stopped.source: M6-S3's harness assertion (DL-59, DL-69): no hero.transferred names the player's Guild; 0 at v1.1.6's close (DL-205)

unfinished.source: M2-S12 (DL-34): every game ends or plays to its last Turn; 50 of 50 at v1.1.6's close (DL-205)

roundTrips.source: M2-S12 (DL-34): every last save loads and serialises back identically; 50 of 50 at v1.1.6's close (DL-205)

replay.source: M2-S12 (DL-34), since v1.1.6-S3 (DL-189) one seed played once more, alone, its last save's length and fingerprint compared with those its shard recorded: two processes; seed-0001 identical at v1.1.6's close, 144,370,431 characters (DL-205); at v1.1.5's, 144,371,849, played twice in one process then (DL-181, DL-184)

playerBankruptcies.source: the owner's answer (DL-188): at most 3 of 50, the baseline and fifty seeds' ±3 (DL-166), as proposed; v1.1.6's closing full gate: 0 of 50 (DL-205), as v1.1.5's closing sweep (DL-184); DL-168 item 16's 3 to 7 decided what followed v1.1.5 and is not this line

saveGzipped.source: the owner's answer (DL-188): "stay under 30mb", the mean over the run's games, not every save, measured gzipped as the page keeps it (DL-67, DL-186 item 21, data-model §7); no guard on the uncompressed size, which the report prints; v1.1.6's closing full gate: mean 17.95 MiB, max 21.08 MiB gzipped (DL-205), as v1.1.5's closing sweep (DL-184)

copyShare.source: the owner's answer (DL-203): "Mean ≤ baseline +25%", restated by the owner as the copy's share of a Turn (DL-206 item 17, DL-205's finding that the copy's milliseconds follow the machine's load): the mean time of the per-Turn copy (copyWorld, ADR-0011) over the run, timed as each year ended, over the mean time of advance, may grow at most 25% over its baseline share without a DL entry; the baseline measured at v1.1.6-S17's full gate (DL-203; harness/reports/m9-v116-s17-2026-10-05, 50 games of 20 years, 8 processes): copy mean 0.847 ms over 1,000 copies, advance mean 3.346 ms, share 0.253, at most 0.31625

noOneFalls.source: v1.1.4-S5 (DL-156): every chance within 2 points of the resolver's rate with no one falling; held at v1.1.6's close, the widest 1.18 points (DL-205, harness/reports/m9-estimate-2026-10-06), as at v1.1.5's re-close (DL-185)

moraleInQuest.source: v1.1.5-S7 (DL-173, the owner's answer): the Quest's bands and success within 3 points with Morale's consequences in; held at v1.1.6's close, the widest 1.61 points (DL-205, harness/reports/m9-estimate-2026-10-06), as at v1.1.5's re-close (DL-185)

notes: Drafted by v1.1.6-S2 from v1.1.5's epic and closing sweep, and approved by the owner on 2026-10-05 with the Traits a career taken out and the save's gzipped mean set under 30 MiB, no guard on its uncompressed size (DL-188). Its lines and baselines change only with a DL entry (DL-186 item 13).
The bands are set on the run above: on a run of another shape they read not comparable. The estimate's two limits are checked by npm run harness -- estimate, not by a gate run.
S17 added the per-Turn copy's time line (DL-186 item 11, DL-203), its baseline set from S17's full gate by its verification; v1.1.7-S1 made it the copy's share of a Turn (DL-206 item 17, DL-207).

v1.1.7-S8 moved the baseline from v1.1.5's closing sweep to v1.1.6's closing full gate, and the sources whose numbers were v1.1.5's with it; no limit changed, each baseline's value the same at both closes, and the copy line as S1 set it (DL-214).
